title: Where in Arkansas State Parks is Carmen Sandiego?
subtitle: Arkansas State Parks Division
intro: Carmen has altered ACME’s park-history files. Compare source notes, reconstruct events and challenge unsupported claims across eight Arkansas state parks, with three case variants at each stop. This is a curated investigation, not a driving itinerary. All ACME desks, suspects and case records are fictional. Map pins are approximate orientation points, not entrances or travel directions. Every puzzle is solvable from written evidence.
